items.title: ‘The estrangement isn’t about politics’: My daughter hasn’t spoken to me for 4 years. Do I leave her a monthly annuity?
items.description: “You’ll have to trust me when I tell you that she had love, support and opportunities.”

items.title: Canada announces retaliatory tariffs on U.S. goods after trade talks break down
items.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on Saturday announced his country would impose “dollar-for-dollar” tariffs on U.S. goods — a retaliatory measure after trade talks between the two nations broke dow

items.title: ‘We are committed Christians’: Our son and daughter-in-law cut us off over politics. Should we change our $3 million will?
items.description: “We are hurt and confused, but we have also tried to respect the boundaries they have established.”

items.title: ‘She looked into COBRA’: My friend was laid off and lost her health insurance. How can she find affordable coverage?
I hold my mother-in-law’s power of attorney. I’m also her executor and trustee. Do I have too much power over her affairs?
items.description: “There is a lot of legal and financial power in my hands.”

items.title: ‘I’m running out of time’: I sold my $300,000 rental property at a $75,000 loss. Should I buy another one to avoid taxes?
items.description: “My CPA hasn’t gotten back to me.”

items.title: Our 4-year-old son has $100,000 in his 529 account. Is a bull market a bad time to buy him stocks instead?
items.description: “I’d love for our son to be able to attend college without needing to take out student loans.”

items.title: Why an announcement from the Treasury sparked a rally in gold and bitcoin this week
items.description: Cryptocurrencies and precious metals shot higher, while the U.S. dollar weakened, after the Treasury Department said it planned to double its bond buybacks.

items.title: Move over, credit cards: Social-media stars are tapping magic wands to buy things
items.description: Tap-to-pay is getting a TikTok makeover as shoppers turn checking out into a personalized accessory.

items.title: ‘There is considerable tension’: My grandmother, 99, wants to cut my mother out of her will. Should I intervene?
items.description: “Grandma feels that she was pressured by my mother into taking out a $50,000 HELOC.”
